**Associate Professor of Linguistics**\

## About Me

My research is about finding **new ways** to solve hard problems in historical
linguistics, more and more often with computers. I especially work on
*Proto-Indo-European* (PIE), the reconstructed ancestor of most of the languages of
Europe, Iran, and northern India.

I also try to bring PIE to the public, through constructed languages for games and
TV, translations, and interviews.

## What I Work On

::: {.cards}
::: {.card}
### DERBi PIE
A searchable database of PIE roots, built from several etymological dictionaries.
:::

::: {.card}
### Immersive PIE
With Brenna Byrd: a textbook and four novellas that teach PIE through stories.
:::

::: {.card}
### Conlangs
Languages for games like *Far Cry Primal* and *Flintlock: The Siege of Dawn*.
:::
:::
